key.description: The key that was asked for, echoed back verbatim. Not validated against the known-key list: `config unset` deletes for every key class, so a key stride has never read is as valid a target as one it does.

removed.description: Whether a row actually existed and was deleted. False means the key was already absent — not an error, because the requested end state (no row) is the state you are now in. Distinguishing the two matters for a caller that wants to know whether it changed anything, which is why this is a flag rather than a silent success.
